column1: # Code compiled into rusty_v8's prebuilt archives. archive_path is a source
# directory the archives' debug strings name: a top-level directory, or one
# third_party/<name>. source is where its license comes from: a rusty_v8
# submodule at the release tag ("submodule:<path>"), or a pinned base URL; "-"
# with file "-" means another section of THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md covers it.
# Chromium's build/ has no license file of its own; its sources defer to
# Chromium's, pinned at the release line matching V8 15.2.
# rusty_v8's own bindings: the v8 crate in the Rust crates section.
